mkdir -p build && cat > report.py <<'EOF'
"""Build build/backtest.json: last vs mean5 over seeds 0-9, gap-free targets only.

Missing-day rule: a target date is scored only if it and the 5 calendar days
before it are all observed, so "last" is yesterday and "mean5" is the mean of
the previous five calendar days. Both methods are scored on the same dates.
Window: every date meeting that rule (no further trimming).
"""
from datetime import date, timedelta
import json
import sys

from run import series

SEEDS = range(10)
CLAIMED_REDUCTION = 0.20


def run_for_seed(seed):
    rows = series(seed)
    by_date = {date.fromisoformat(r["date"]): r["value"] for r in rows}
    first, last_d = min(by_date), max(by_date)
    calendar_days = (last_d - first).days + 1
    scored = []
    for target in sorted(by_date):
        prev = [target - timedelta(days=k) for k in range(1, 6)]
        if not all(p in by_date for p in prev):
            continue
        actual = by_date[target]
        scored.append((target, abs(actual - by_date[prev[0]]),
                       abs(actual - sum(by_date[p] for p in prev) / 5)))
    n = len(scored)
    mae_last = sum(s[1] for s in scored) / n
    mae_mean5 = sum(s[2] for s in scored) / n
    return {
        "seed": seed,
        "calendar_days": calendar_days,
        "observed_days": len(by_date),
        "missing_days": calendar_days - len(by_date),
        "scored_count": n,
        "skipped_targets": len(by_date) - n,
        "scored_dates": [s[0].isoformat() for s in scored],
        "mae_last": mae_last,
        "mae_mean5": mae_mean5,
        "mean5_reduction_vs_last": (mae_last - mae_mean5) / mae_last,
    }


def build():
    runs = [run_for_seed(s) for s in SEEDS]
    pooled_last = sum(r["mae_last"] * r["scored_count"] for r in runs) / sum(r["scored_count"] for r in runs)
    pooled_mean5 = sum(r["mae_mean5"] * r["scored_count"] for r in runs) / sum(r["scored_count"] for r in runs)
    reduction = (pooled_last - pooled_mean5) / pooled_last
    met = [r["seed"] for r in runs if r["mean5_reduction_vs_last"] >= CLAIMED_REDUCTION]
    conclusion = {
        "claim": "mean5 cuts MAE by at least 20% versus last",
        "supported": not (reduction < CLAIMED_REDUCTION or len(met) < len(runs)),
        "pooled_mae_last": pooled_last,
        "pooled_mae_mean5": pooled_mean5,
        "pooled_reduction": reduction,
        "seeds_meeting_claim": met,
        "summary": (
            f"Not supported. Pooled MAE: last {pooled_last:.3f}, mean5 {pooled_mean5:.3f} units/day; "
            f"mean5 is {-reduction:.0%} worse, not 20% better, on all {len(runs)} seeds. "
            "The series trends +1 unit/day with noise of only +/-0.2, so the lag of a 5-day mean "
            "(about 3 units) dwarfs any noise it removes."
        ) if reduction < CLAIMED_REDUCTION else "Supported on pooled MAE.",
    }
    return {
        "units": "units per day (MAE)",
        "seeds": list(SEEDS),
        "method": {
            "last": "previous calendar day's value",
            "mean5": "mean of the previous five calendar days",
            "missing_day_rule": "target scored only if it and the 5 preceding calendar days are observed",
            "window": "all dates satisfying the rule",
            "data_note": "Generated history is NOT complete: 5 calendar days per seed are missing "
                         "(every 17th day), contrary to the premise of daily coverage.",
        },
        "runs": runs,
        "conclusion": conclusion,
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    out = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "build/backtest.json"
    with open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(build(), f, indent=2)
        f.write("\n")
EOF
cat >> tests/test_run.py <<'EOF'


def test_report_scores_only_gap_free_targets():
    from report import run_for_seed
    from datetime import date
    r = run_for_seed(7)
    assert r["missing_days"] == 5 and r["calendar_days"] == 100
    dates = {date.fromisoformat(d) for d in r["scored_dates"]}
    assert date(2025, 1, 18) not in dates  # day 17 missing
    assert date(2025, 1, 19) not in dates  # day 18 follows a gap
    assert r["mae_mean5"] > r["mae_last"]
